aggregates.claim: A finite ledger over the exact current collected suite, with every execution ID, primary requirement, input/profile fingerprint, current adjudication, declared phase and evidence class bound into the inventory review. Inventory adjudication is distinct from case approval: explicit current needs-oracle or disputed members remain listed, unapproved and ineligible for qualified passes. Unreviewed, stale or falsely labelled reference evidence cannot be silently adopted. Declared-valid runtime effects, other effects, positive admission controls, undefined-result contexts and invalid-input diagnostics have separate populations. Actual observations are joined by exact ID and compiler configuration without adding an execution or attributing a canonical case to this requirement.
aggregates.limitation: Observational infrastructure only: S4.2-001's facet remains pending until the source/requirement census, complete conforming fixture/oracle inventory and separate processor/dependency qualifications are independently established. No finite run proves the universal processor obligation. A filtered invocation retains all unselected members in its denominator. XFAILs remain failures; skips, unsupported modes, missing profiles, unavailable launchers, unexecuted run effects and provisional observations cannot become qualified passes. A compile/link admission is not execution of an interpretation, and a context-only run is not an assertion about an undefined value. Resource failures do not establish permitted size/complexity limits. Compiler headers, companions, launchers and profile observations describe the selected interface, not ABI certification or universal portability. Paragraphs 7-8 are recommendations, not manufactured mandatory documentation requirements.

review.rationale: Explicit source-context renewal of the unchanged 2083-member inventory after the independently reviewed 10.1.9.1, 10.1.9.2 and 10.1.9.3 source registration in doc/source_audits/batch_104.json. All 2083 case bindings, their fingerprints, 2047 raw reviews, 203 older catalogues, 22 links, R402 and the b153c75b baseline remain exact. Only 10 of the 18 scoped base units are newly accounted: R1025, C1007, R1026, C1008, R1027, C1009, R1028 and C1010 were already accounted by the numbered-rule inventory, and the reviewer verified each independently as neither double-counted nor dropped. 81 new facets remain pending. The reviewer derived the 10.1.9.3 result-kind rules independently from the pinned source before comparing: integer with real or complex uses the real or complex operand kind, different-range integer pairs require the greater RANGE kind and different-precision real or complex pairs the greater PRECISION kind, but equal-range integer, equal-precision real or complex, and different-kind logical results require only that the kind be one of the operand kinds, with the choice processor dependent. Those three, together with the 10.1.9.2 p3 disassociated-pointer phrase that only allows contexts explicitly permitted elsewhere, are recorded as permissions; both failure directions were checked, and no genuine requirement was demoted into an untestable processor-choice oracle. No plan hard-codes a kind value, predicts which operand kind is selected, or assumes that multiple nondefault kinds exist. Vacuity was checked: LEN is asserted explicitly for character length, disassociated pointers and unallocated allocatables receive no SHAPE oracle, and the binary-operation shape plan warns that two conformable arrays cannot discriminate the x1-shape rule. No table is a base unit in this scope; Table 10.2 remains owned by 10.1.5.1. No expression-characteristic, primary-characteristic or result-characteristic execution, canonical link or SourceUse observation is supplied, and no compiler was invoked. The eight substring executions integrated in batch099 remain the latest actual observations. All pending facets, unresolved units, the retained needs-oracle real-BOZ block and every global gate remain open.
